method: Installed image tool generated isolated pigment on white. White discarded; selected strokes mapped to ochre and charcoal and blended onto exact inherited stone.
visual_review: Inspected final full PNG and 512px JPEG. Pepe retains a wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes and both inherited five-digit hands; no hands were added. No letters, numbers, captions, logos, borders, real people or prohibited symbols observed. Existing marks, rock, cracks, light and framing are retained; the new bowl does not touch the older branch.
unmet_visual_requirements: Inherited rock texture remains photographic in detail; retained to preserve the existing wall.
limitations: The ring and stones soften at 512px.
Local visual review is not independent approval.
